about_the_game:
CHRONO PORT: HEROES OF ALL TIME

Travel through time, unite legendary heroes, and save the world.

Brief Overview:

Chrono Port: Heroes of All Time is a strategic role-playing game (RPG) where players embark on a journey through time, recruiting legendary heroes from different eras to save the world from an ancient evil. Combining turn-based combat, exploration, and character progression, players use the powerful Chrono-Porter to unite a diverse team of heroes from across time and space.

Game Genre:

Turn-Based RPG, Hero Collection, Time-Travel Adventure

Target Platforms:

PC, Console, Mobile

THE STORY

A boy playing with his drone dreams of adventure.



He hears a loud noise and runs to the window.



Stepping outside, he witnesses a massive monster wreaking havoc on the city.



He tries to fight, but an old Master stops him.


The Master reveals a long-kept secret—the existence of the Chrono Port.


He entrusts the boy with it and tasks him with summoning heroes from across time to save the world.

HEROES AND VILLAINS

Heroes:

  • Unlock and recruit 60 legendary heroes from different time periods and mythologies.

  • Each hero has unique abilities, attributes, and backstories, offering varied playstyles and strategies.

  • Customize heroes via skill trees to shape their roles—Tank, Healer, or Mage.

  • Equip them with powerful items and stat enhancers to increase their combat effectiveness.

  • As heroes level up, allocate skill points to unlock or enhance abilities.

Villains:

  • Face 30 unique villains, including mythical beasts, warlords, sorcerers, and legendary monsters.

  • Each villain presents tactical challenges requiring strategy and team synergy.

  • Every world ends with a powerful boss fight featuring special abilities and environmental threats.

BATTLE DYNAMICS

Roles:

  • Each role is color-coded:
    • Green – Healer
    • Red – Warrior
    • Blue – Mage

Progression:

  • Frequently used heroes earn XP and level up.

Currencies & Items:

  • Coins: Used to purchase consumable items.

  • Gems: Unlock stat-enhancing items.

  • Stat Enhancers: Boost hero stats like attack, defense, and health—crucial for tough encounters.

  • Consumable Items: Provide temporary boosts or debuffs, often turning the tide of battle.

Strategic Depth:

  • Swap heroes mid-battle to counter threats or adapt to environments.

  • Master buffs, debuffs, and stuns to control the flow of combat.

CORE MECHANICS

Exploration:


Travel through 60 unique worlds using the Chrono-Porter. Each world features distinct environments, enemies, quests, puzzles, and hidden treasures.

3 vs 3 Turn-Based Combat:

Battle in teams of three heroes. Speed determines turn order. Choose to attack, defend, or swap—every decision matters.

Hero Customization & Progression:
Heroes gain XP from missions and combat. Unlock abilities via skill trees and evolve your team’s strategy.

Resource Management:
Collect and manage coins and gems wisely. Use them to upgrade heroes, unlock items, and progress through increasingly difficult challenges.
